content_sections.heading: DDU College Recruitment 2026 at a Glance
content_sections.text: The official notification does not specify the application fee.

rows.details: Deen Dayal Upadhyaya College, University of Delhi
Device Simulation for Advanced GaN HEMT Architectures for Ka band Applications
CARS, Defense Research and Development Organization (DRDO), Ministry of Defense, Government of India
Up to 31.03.2027 (Likely to be extended for next 6 months)
RA: Rs. 58,000 per month + 30% HRA; Project Associate-I: Rs. 25,000 per month + 30% HRA
Department of Electronics, Deen Dayal Upadhyaya College, New Delhi

content_sections.heading: About DDU College
content_sections.text: Deen Dayal Upadhyaya College is a college of the University of Delhi in New Delhi; the stamp on the notice gives its location as Dwarka Sector-3, New Delhi-110078. These posts sit in its Department of Electronics, under a research project led by Professor Manoj Saxena as Principal Investigator. The project, "Device Simulation for Advanced GaN HEMT Architectures for Ka band Applications", is funded under CARS of the Defense Research and Development Organization (DRDO), Ministry of Defense, Government of India.

content_sections.heading: Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: The notice does not give a category-wise break-up of the posts.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: A candidate for the RA post must meet one of these two conditions: PhD or equivalent degree in Electronics/Physics (with specialization in Electronics) with at least three research papers (on HEMT) in Science Citation Index (SCI) Journal. OR M.E./M. Tech. (with valid NET and/or GATE score) with 3 years of research experience in the field of semiconductor materials device fabrication, characterisation, modelling, and simulation, with at least one research paper in Science Citation Index (SCI) Journal. The age limit printed against both routes is 35 Years. The NET/GATE score and the 3 years of research experience are written only for the M.E./M.Tech. route. The essential qualification is B. Tech./M.Sc. in Electronics/Physics with Electronics / 4 Years B.Sc. in Electronics/Physics. The age limit is 27 Years. The notice does not mention any research experience for this post. The notice does not print an "as on" date for counting age or any age relaxation. Candidates should check the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of each post.

rows.essential_qualification: PhD route or M.E./M.Tech. route (see below)
B. Tech./M.Sc. in Electronics/Physics with Electronics / 4 Years B.Sc. in Electronics/Physics

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The pay is called a fellowship: Rs. 58,000 per month + 30% HRA for the RA and Rs. 25,000 per month + 30% HRA for each Project Associate-I. The position is temporary and for a period up to 31.03.2027, likely to be extended for next 6 months. If the candidate's performance is found unsatisfactory, the position can be terminated with 1 month's notice.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for DDU College Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Prepare your CV. Scan self-attested copies of your educational certificates and mark sheets, class XII onwards. Scan a self-attested copy of your UGC-NET/CSIR-NET/GATE qualified certificate. Scan self-attested proof of research experience, special achievements and publications, if any. Keep all documents as soft copies in PDF format. Email them to the Principal Investigator at [email protected] with the subject "Application for Research Associate (1) and Project Assistant (2) position, CARS-DRDO Project".

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Only shortlisted candidates will be informed through email and called for interview in person. At the interview they must bring the originals of degrees, certificates and date of birth proof, along with any other relevant information such as copies of publications and awards, if applicable. The interview date and venue will be communicated by email to shortlisted candidates; the notice does not print them.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: No TA/DA will be paid for attending the interview. For any queries regarding the position, candidates may email the PI at [email protected] .

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in DDU College Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 3 vacancies: one Research Associate (RA) and two Project Associate-I in the CARS-DRDO funded project at the Department of Electronics.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: Applications must be sent within 10 days from the date of the advertisement, 4 November 2026, which is about 14 November 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is needed for the Research Associate post?
faq.answer: PhD or equivalent in Electronics/Physics (with specialization in Electronics) with at least three SCI papers on HEMT, or M.E./M.Tech. with valid NET and/or GATE score, 3 years of relevant research experience and at least one SCI paper.

faq.question: Q4. What qualification is needed for Project Associate-I?
faq.answer: B. Tech./M.Sc. in Electronics/Physics with Electronics / 4 Years B.Sc. in Electronics/Physics.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: The age limit is 35 Years for the Research Associate and 27 Years for Project Associate-I.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary for these posts?
faq.answer: The Research Associate gets Rs. 58,000 per month + 30% HRA and each Project Associate-I gets Rs. 25,000 per month + 30% HRA.

faq.question: Q7. Is HRA paid on top of the fellowship?
faq.answer: Yes, the notice adds 30% HRA to the monthly fellowship of both posts.

faq.question: Q8. How do I apply and what subject should the email have?
faq.answer: Email your CV and self-attested scanned documents in PDF format to [email protected] with the subject "Application for Research Associate (1) and Project Assistant (2) position, CARS-DRDO Project".

faq.question: Q9. How will candidates be selected?
faq.answer: Only shortlisted candidates will be informed by email and called for an interview in person with original degrees, certificates and date of birth proof. No TA/DA is paid for attending.

faq.question: Q10. Is this a permanent job?
faq.answer: No, the position is temporary, up to 31.03.2027 and likely to be extended for next 6 months; it can be terminated with 1 month's notice if performance is unsatisfactory.
